candidates.source_name: НБРСМ — Соопштенија (press releases / announcements, per-year index, 2026)
candidates.why_relevant: In the absence of a dedicated consultation portal, the National Bank's dated announcements stream is where NBRM actually signals regulatory work: Council sessions that adopt draft/final decisions, invitations for comments, and publication of new bylaws. Year-indexed URL pattern (soopstenija-YYYY.nspx) makes it trivially crawlable and diffable for A3 deadline objects.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled headless-browser fetch (site 403s plain HTTP clients incl. curl with UA spoof); parse per-year index, diff item list daily, extract dates + decision titles; year URL pattern is predictable so pre-seed soopstenija-2027 etc.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search then snowball from search-result URL pattern

candidates.source_name: НБРСМ — Програма за работа на Народната банка (annual work programme)
candidates.why_relevant: This is the closest thing NBRM publishes to a regulatory work programme / calendar: the Council adopts a Work Programme each December (e.g. Programme for 2026 adopted 5 Dec 2025) listing planned regulatory activities for the year. It is the single best forward-looking A3 artefact for anticipating which decisions will be drafted and when.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual headless-browser fetch each December/January; download the attached PDF and extract the planned-regulation table into dated obligation objects.
queries_used: nbrm.mk "Програма за работа" Народна банка 2026 регулаторни активности донесување одлуки

candidates.source_name: НБРСМ — Стратегиски план на Народната банка (multi-year strategic plan)
candidates.why_relevant: Rolling 3-year strategic plans (2019-2021, 2020-2022, 2022-2024, and per press coverage a 2025-2027 plan) set the medium-term regulatory agenda that the annual Work Programme operationalises. Gives 2-3 year lead time on themes (EU acquis alignment, payments, resolution, digitalisation) before any draft decision appears.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless-browser fetch of the ns-newsarticle-strategiski-plan-* slug family; search site for the newest period slug annually.

candidates.source_name: НБРСМ — Регулатива за платните системи и платежните услуги (payments regulation hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Topic hub listing every decision/instruction under the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems (ЗПУПС, Off. Gazette 90/22, applicable from 1 Jan 2023). candidates.why_relevant: NBRM's curated list of the primary laws it administers (Banking Law, Law on the National Bank, ЗПУПС, Law on Bank Resolution, FX Law). candidates.source_name: ЕНЕР — Единствен национален електронски регистар на прописи (national e-register of regulations / public consultation portal)
candidates.why_relevant: THE statutory public-consultation venue in North Macedonia. Ministries must publish draft laws and the Извештај за процена на влијанието на регулативата (ПВР / RIA) on ENER with an open comment window (normally 20-40 days). Banking and payments primary law (Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems, FX Law, financial discipline) is consulted here by the Ministry of Finance, with NBRM as substantive drafter. Comment deadlines on ENER are literal A3 deadline objects.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the regulation listing daily; item detail pages use a stable pattern Default.aspx?item=pub_regulation&subitem=view_reg_detail&itemid=NNNNN, so numeric-id sweeps plus keyword filters (банк, платеж, девиз, финанс, Народна банка) work well. Capture title, proposing ministry, publication date, comment deadline, and the ПВР attachment.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on RIA terminology, then verified host reachability

negative_findings.description: No dedicated NBRM public-consultation portal was found. Searches in Macedonian for 'јавна консултација', 'консултативен документ', 'нацрт-одлука ставена на увид на јавноста', 'забелешки и предлози', and in English for 'public consultation' / 'draft decision' / 'comments deadline' on nbrm.mk returned only final adopted decisions, consolidated texts and press releases — never a consultation landing page, a draft open for comment, or a feedback statement.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBRM appears not to operate an ECB/EBA-style consultation hub with published comment windows and published responses. Consultation appears to run through the banking association and working groups, and, for primary legislation, through ENER (Ministry of Finance as proposer).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core premise — that consultation drafts are the earliest legally-visible signal — holds for LAWS (via ENER) but only weakly for NBRM BYLAWS. For bylaws the earliest reliable public signal is the annual Work Programme plus the post-Council-session announcement, which arrives at adoption, not before. Collection design must lean on ENER + Work Programme + MBA rather than on a nonexistent NBRM consultation feed.

negative_findings.description: www.nbrm.mk returns HTTP 403 Forbidden to WebFetch and to curl with a realistic desktop Chrome User-Agent, on both the homepage and deep pages (e.g. /regulativa.nspx, /rieghulativa_za_platnitie_sistiemi.nspx).
negative_findings.result_summary: 0 of 2 curl probes and 1 of 1 WebFetch probe succeeded; response bodies ~5.6-5.8 KB, consistent with a WAF challenge page rather than a real 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source family in this cell is not collectible with plain HTTP. This is a HYPOTHESIS of bot protection, not evidence the site is dead — the same URLs are indexed and returned by search engines. Any collector for MK/A3 must budget for a headless browser or an authorised feed.

negative_findings.description: finance.gov.mk and vlada.mk both timed out after 25 seconds from this environment; ener.gov.mk root returned 200 but the guessed listing path Default.aspx?item=pub_regulation returned 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ministry of Finance and Government hosts unverified; ENER root live but its listing route must be discovered from the rendered UI rather than guessed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Do not record these as dead. The ENER item-detail route (Default.aspx?item=pub_regulation&subitem=view_reg_detail&itemid=NNNNN) is confirmed from indexed URLs, so the listing route exists under a different parameter set and needs one browser session to capture.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian-language hits were found for a regulator-published 'impact assessment' of an NBRM bylaw. ПВР (Проценка на влијанието на регулативата) is a Government/ministry instrument tied to ENER and draft LAWS; nothing indicates NBRM publishes RIA documents for its own decisions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Impact assessments in MK are a ministry obligation, not a central-bank one.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'impact assessments' element of this coverage cell should be re-scoped to ENER/ministry ПВР reports on financial-sector bills, and the run should not expect NBRM-authored impact assessments.

negative_findings.description: Acronym drift is a real collection hazard: the institution is НБРМ (Народна банка на Република Македонија) pre-2019 and НБРСМ / 'Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија' after, while the domain and much English content still say NBRM. Older PDFs are headed 'НАРОДНА БАНКА НА РЕПУБЛИКА МАКЕДОНИЈА'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries using only one variant miss material; 'НБРСМ' in particular returned poorer results than the spelled-out modern name.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any keyword-based collector or alerting rule must carry all of: НБРМ, НБРСМ, Народна банка, National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia, National Bank of North Macedonia, NBRNM.

negative_findings.description: 'консултација' in Macedonian search is dominated by IMF Article IV consultations and by World-Bank/PEFA environmental-and-social 'јавна консултација' notices, and 'предлог' matches every government bill in the country.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both seed-query terms are low-precision on their own.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Queries must be anchored with an institution token ('Народна банка', site:nbrm.mk) or a domain token ('платежни услуги', 'супервизија') to be usable in an automated discovery loop.

coverage_gaps.description: The entire nbrm.mk source family — the cell's centre of gravity — is unreachable by the tooling available in this run (403 WAF).

coverage_gaps.description: No official NBRM RSS/Atom feed, e-mail alert list, or open-data/API endpoint for regulation was identified, and no NBRM Official-Gazette-linked machine-readable register was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe conventional feed paths on nbrm.mk from a browser context and check the site footer for a newsletter subscription; if none exists, fall back to scheduled diffing plus the media/social mirrors listed as candidates.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/backfill strategy was established for withdrawn or superseded drafts; NBRM republishes consolidated texts in place ('пречистен текст'), so prior versions and their transition deadlines silently disappear.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair the collector with Wayback Machine snapshots of nbrm.mk/regulativa.nspx and the payments regulation hub, and hash-archive every PDF at first sight.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage was not attempted, although Albanian is an official language in North Macedonia and some government consultation material is issued bilingually.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a short Albanian-language pass (e.g. 'Banka Popullore e Republikës së Maqedonisë së Veriut', 'projektvendim', 'konsultim publik', 'afati për komente') against ENER and government portals.

brief: For North Macedonia there is no ECB-style NBRM consultation portal: extensive Macedonian- and English-language searching surfaced only adopted decisions, consolidated texts and Council-session press releases on nbrm.mk, never a draft open for comment with a published deadline. The genuine consultation venue for banking and payments PRIMARY law is ENER (ener.gov.mk), the statutory national e-register where ministries must post draft laws with a Regulatory Impact Assessment (ПВР) and an open comment window — confirmed by live financial-sector items such as the draft amendments to the Law on Foreign Exchange Operations. For NBRM BYLAWS the earliest public signals are instead the annual Програма за работа and the 3-year Стратегиски план (forward-looking regulatory calendars), the NPAA EU-alignment matrices which date obligations by chapter and responsible institution, and industry channels (Македонска банкарска асоцијација) where NBRM consults banks non-publicly. Critically, the whole nbrm.mk host returns HTTP 403 to plain HTTP clients while remaining fully search-indexed, so this cell's core sources require a headless browser and should be treated as bot-defended-but-live, with national wire media and NBRM's social accounts as unblocked mirrors.
